description: This file implements the GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient class, which manages media playback, source attachment, seeking, and interaction with a media backend in a GStreamer-based media player for Media Source Extensions (MSE). It handles media data notifications, playback state changes, and buffer pulling, acting as a bridge between the media pipeline and the client backend.

classes.name: GStreamerMSEMediaPlayerClient
classes.description: Main class managing media playback, source attachment, seeking, and interaction with the media backend, including buffer management and playback state handling.

classes.name: BufferPuller
classes.description: Handles requesting and pulling media buffers from the sink, running in its own message queue.

classes.name: HaveDataMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling 'have data' events, indicating media data availability.

classes.name: PullBufferMessage
classes.description: Message class for requesting and processing media buffer samples from the sink.

classes.name: PlaybackStateMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling playback state changes.

classes.name: QosMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling Quality of Service (QoS) updates.

classes.name: BufferUnderflowMessage
classes.description: Message class for handling buffer underflow events.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Initializes the media backend, creating the media pipeline and loading media.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the player, setting up buffer pullers.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the player.

methods.name: requestPullBuffer
methods.description: Requests buffer data for a specific stream.

methods.name: handleQos
methods.description: Handles QoS updates for a source.

methods.name: handleBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Handles buffer underflow events for a source.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video display rectangle based on a string input.

methods.name: getVideoRectangle
methods.description: Returns the current video rectangle as a string.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame from the sink.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Gets the current playback volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Returns the mute state.

methods.name: setAudioStreamsInfo
methods.description: Sets information about audio streams.

methods.name: setVideoStreamsInfo
methods.description: Sets information about video streams.

methods.name: areAllStreamsAttached
methods.description: Checks if all expected streams are attached.

methods.name: startPullingDataIfSeekFinished
methods.description: Starts data pulling after a seek operation is completed.

methods.name: handlePlaybackStateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in playback state.
